# Hejmdal Privathospital Viby

Hejmdal Privathospital Viby is a private hospital treatment unit ("beh.afsnit") in Denmark that appears in the Danish ADHD quality database (ADHD-databasen) covering the reporting period 01.04.2024–31.03.2025 [^src1][^src2]. The entity is documented twice in the corpus, both times in connection with poor performance on the database's ADHD assessment quality indicators.

According to the data, Hejmdal Privathospital Viby recorded 0% fulfillment on indicator 2a and 0% on indicator 2b [^src1]. Indicator 2a and 2b measure the frequency of manualized diagnostic interviews or structured clinical environment observation as part of ADHD diagnostic workups for children and young people [^src1][^src2]. A further mention shows the unit scoring 0 out of 5 (0%, range 0–52) on a related measure [^src2]. These figures place Hejmdal Privathospital Viby well below the national development target of 90% fulfillment that applies across all regions and psychiatric departments in the ADHD database [^src1][^src2].

This performance stands in sharp contrast to other reporting units in the same dataset, such as departments in Vejle and Aabenraa, which reportedly achieved 100% on indicator 2a, while Region Sjælland and Region Nordjylland also lagged behind the national target [^src1]. The broader dataset attributes underperformance across departments to barriers including geographic challenges, registration problems, and variable waiting times affecting the quality of ADHD assessment nationally [^src1]. Hejmdal Privathospital Viby's 0% scores on both indicators make it one of the more extreme examples of non-implementation of the manualized diagnostic interview/environment observation standard within this national quality monitoring exercise, though the underlying data does not specify a cause for this specific unit's results.

No relationships or additional claims involving Hejmdal Privathospital Viby are documented in the corpus beyond these performance figures, and no timeline events are recorded for this entity specifically.
